review_policy.approve: Approve rows where the source->target mapping is a usable visible replacement sense and active evidence can plausibly improve runtime semantic decisions.
review_policy.exclude_no_visible_replacement: Exclude rows where source and target render as the same browser text, because the user would not see a useful replacement.
review_policy.exclude_weak_source_target_mapping: Exclude rows where the target is a weak, archaic, idiomatic-only, or visibly wrong replacement for the English source.
review_policy.not_a_veto_accuracy_claim: This review validates paid generation inputs only; it does not score the veto algorithm.
